Arteta sets Arsenal a 100-point target for the Premier League season

Mikel Arteta · Sport

Arsenal lead Manchester City by six points after 11 games before Sunday's meeting at the Emirates Stadium. Arteta was an assistant to Pep Guardiola when Manchester City reached 100 points in 2017-18. City finished 19 points ahead of second-placed Manchester United that season.

Reported by The Guardian; ESPN.
